source: Licensed-Home-Trade-Field-Mapping — 2026-11-19 — Rev 9, updated for Spec v2.8 (2026-11-19): points per Allocation v2; G1 exact name and G6 verifiable listing added as scored Items; C3.2 and C4.1 marked not scored (Ranking Suggestions, Section 4, Complete/Suggested/Not checked); Section 6 factors coded S1-S6. The gates list is retained ONLY for the agent-observation scorer path (agent/scorer.py scores Gates as Not observed by rule); the scored audit has no Gates. Spec s.13 (v2.6): new audits record spec_version '2.6' with 36 rows (0/7/21/8); C3.2 and C4.1 are Ranking Suggestion rows (Tim's decision 2026-11-18, decision 10).

gates.fields: Business name on website; business name on Google, Meta, and Yelp listings
gates.sources: Website header/footer; Google Business Profile; Meta place; Yelp listing
gates.pass_criteria: Exact name identical everywhere, or an old-to-new mapping page if rebranded
gates.evidence: Name as shown on each source, with source URL and date
gates.fail_if: Name differs on any checked source and no old-to-new mapping page explains it

gates.fields: Install/replacement service and repair service, stated separately, in plain words
gates.sources: Website service pages; Google and Meta service listings
gates.pass_criteria: Installation/replacement AND repair, as separate services, in plain words
gates.evidence: Service wording as shown, with source URL and date
gates.fail_if: Installation/replacement OR repair missing, or lumped together without separate plain-words wording

gates.pass_criteria: Town and ZIP explicitly named, not only a region; or street address in or near the town
gates.evidence: Service-area wording / address, with source URL and date
gates.fail_if: Neither town and ZIP nor a street address in or near the town is explicitly stated

gates.fields: Phone number(s); booking, quote, or contact route
gates.sources: Website; Google, Meta, and Yelp listings
gates.pass_criteria: One unique primary phone number everywhere for that location, plus a working booking, quote, or contact route
gates.evidence: Phone as shown on each source; route tested or noted as Not checked
gates.fix_type: Website change; Listing change; Operational change
gates.fail_if: More than one phone for the location, no unique primary phone identified, or no working booking/quote/contact route

gates.fields: Day-by-day hours; 24-hour / weekend / emergency claims; closed flag
gates.pass_criteria: Readable day-by-day hours, or a verifiable 24-hour or emergency claim, with no closed flag
gates.evidence: Hours as shown, with source URL and date
gates.fix_type: Website change; Listing change; Operational change
gates.fail_if: No readable day-by-day hours and no verifiable 24-hour or emergency claim, or a closed flag is present

gates.fields: Listing outside the firm's own website, with name, phone, service area, and Primary Business Category
gates.sources: Google Business Profile, Meta place, Yelp, or similar
gates.pass_criteria: Listing exists outside the website, same name, phone, and service area, correct Primary Business Category
gates.evidence: Listing source, URL, name, phone, category, and date
gates.fail_if: No listing outside the website after checking Google, Meta, and Yelp, or the listing does not match name, phone, service area, or Primary Business Category

levers.fields: Online booking/quote form works; quote in writing before work; stated response time met
levers.sources: Website form (publicly checkable whether it exists/submits); firm evidence or disclosed test for response performance
levers.if_not_observed: Show Recommendation; firm re-checks for automated observation; if still not observed, it stays a Recommendation, with the original score unchanged
